meta.title: Goat Yoga Gone Wrong — Farm Animal Fitness Fails

scenes.narration_en: A goat attempts downward dog at the farm yoga class.
A chicken tries to join but keeps pecking the yoga mat.
The cow watches judgmentally from the fence, unimpressed.
The goat falls over mid-pose, sending everyone into chaos.
The farm dog tries to herd the yoga class back into order.
